description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for handling email notifications related to customer account approval and denial within the admin interface of an OpenCart project. It includes methods for sending approval and denial emails to customers, loading models, retrieving store, language, and customer data, and queuing email tasks.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Controller class for handling customer account-related email notifications (approval and denial) in the admin area.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Handles sending an approval email to a customer, preparing email content based on store and language info, and queuing the email task.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Handles sending a denial email to a customer, preparing email content, and queuing the email task.
